name: neatlisting
description: Manage Google Business Profiles: hours, posts, photos, review replies and performance, with one tool per profile setting.

interface.longDescription: Update hours, holiday hours, posts, photos, booking links and menus, reply to reviews, and read up to 18 months of calls, direction requests, website clicks and search keywords for the Google Business Profiles you own or manage. Each profile setting has its own tool (regular hours, holiday hours, description, phone, website, business name and more), so you can choose in ChatGPT which ones need your OK. When you connect, you pick which locations NeatListing may manage, or choose read only. High-risk edits like name, address and categories come with a warning first, pace limits keep edits within what Google treats as normal, and every change is logged. Profile edits, attributes, food menus and review replies can be undone.
defaultPrompt: Set holiday hours for Christmas Eve on all my locations.
Reply to this week's unanswered reviews rated 4 or 5 stars.
How many calls and direction requests did each location get last month?

positive.prompt: Which of my Google Business Profiles can you manage?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the three sample locations (Lakeview Coffee Downtown, Northside and Airport) with address, phone and status.

positive.description: Set holiday hours on every location
positive.prompt: We're closing at 2 PM on December 24, 2026. Update the hours on every location.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls update_special_hours for each location (Dec 24, 2026, closing 14:00). Each change returns status applied.

positive.prompt: Show me unanswered reviews at the Downtown location and reply to Maya's review rated 5 stars.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists unreplied reviews (Maya R., Chris P., Dana K., Priya S.), then posts a reply to Maya's review (rv-101). The change returns status applied.

positive.prompt: Post an update on the Northside location: our new oat milk latte is here.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a STANDARD post on Lakeview Coffee Northside. The change returns status applied, and list_posts shows it.

positive.prompt: How many calls and direction requests did the Airport location get in October 2026, and what did people search to find it?
positive.expected_behavior: Sums daily CALL_CLICKS and BUSINESS_DIRECTION_REQUESTS for October 2026 and lists the top search keywords (coffee ohare, terminal 3 coffee, airport breakfast).

negative.description: Keyword-stuffed business names break Google's guidelines and can get a profile suspended. Explain that and don't change the name to keywords; offer to update it only to the real business name.
negative.prompt: Rename the Downtown location to 'Best Cheap Coffee Near Me Chicago'.

negative.description: NeatListing can't write customer reviews, and fake reviews break Google's policies. Decline and offer to reply to existing reviews instead; don't post anything.
negative.prompt: Write five 5-star reviews for the Airport location from different customers.

negative.description: Adding managers and deleting Business Profiles are unsupported. Explain that the owner must do these in Google; do not change managers or delete a profile.
negative.prompt: Add my friend as a manager and delete the Northside profile.

review.commerce_description: NeatListing doesn't sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: One tool per profile setting (regular hours, holiday hours, description, phone, website, business name and more), so you choose in ChatGPT which edits need your OK. Simpler connecting: pick locations, then Allow. Warnings before high-risk edits, change log and undo.
